name: zsnd_sample_stop_active_voices_if_playing
description: zSndSample::StopActiveVoicesIfPlaying stops the active primary voice and duplicate voices for the current sound backend when the sample is not a stream-group guard.
known_limits: tier S verification was not attempted in this session. The source intentionally preserves the original mixed report path where duplicate A3D stop failures call zSnd::ReportDirectSoundError.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x49fec0 validates null/create-guard returns, backend 0 DirectSound Stop calls on primary and duplicate voices, backend 1 A3D Stop calls on primary and duplicate voices, unsupported backend success return, and error reporting through the original zSnd source lines.

The native zSound smoke verifies create-guard and missing-primary no-op returns, DirectSound primary plus duplicate stop dispatch, A3D primary plus duplicate stop dispatch, and unsupported-backend no-op success.
